title: goto label structure in ioctl_do_kdf correctly prevents double-unlock and double-free
description: Three-level goto (out_inbuf_clear → out_free_okm → out_zero) with the mutex only covering the first two labels correctly handles every exit path. IKM is always zeroized (inbuf_clear called on every path through out_inbuf_clear), okm_buf is always zeroized and freed (out_free_okm), and the mutex is never double-unlocked. A contributor might suggest 'simplifying' this into nested ifs or a single flat cleanup block — resist that. The current structure is correct precisely because each label owns exactly one resource level. Changing to a single label that checks 'did we take the lock?' introduces a conditional that is easy to get wrong.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Design decisions implemented as described.
